dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

8 پرامپت برای جواب‌های متنوع‌تر 👇
[topic] رو با موضوع خودت عوض کن:

1. "Give me 5 different viewpoints on [topic], including ones most people disagree with."
2. "What would an expert from Iran, Japan or Brazil say about [topic] that a US source might miss?"
3. "What are the strongest arguments against the answer you just gave?"
4. "List the minority or less common positions on [topic] and who holds them."
5. "Which parts of your answer are widely agreed on, and which are still debated?"
6. "Name sources from at least 3 different countries or types of outlet that I can read on [topic]."
7. "What questions should I ask to get a fuller picture of [topic]?"
8. "Answer again, but skip the most common explanation and give me less obvious ones that are still accurate."

و همیشه یه منبع غیر از هوش مصنوعی هم بخون.
منبع: eurekalert.org/news-releases/1145484
